why: owner 25 Nov: 1.0.7 with the marker fixes + the first features from the other translation addons

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.7-beta for WoW Forever 1.60.1.71091

New
- NPC talk and books (settings page 'NPC talk and books'): the gossip window and the quest greeting, what NPCs say / yell / emote in the chat and in their speech bubbles, books, letters and plaques. Persian shows next to the game window or in the chat line; every text that has no Persian yet is kept in English in the status report and in the harvest file, so the next update has it.
- Hold Shift = the game's English original (spell and talent tooltips, the talk pane, NPC chat lines). Switch: General.

Fixes
- Reset all settings keeps your saved profiles and puts every font back at once.
- The game's own font sizes really return to normal.
- Persian chat keeps the game's look: our font only on chat windows that show Persian, the typing box keeps the game font, whole-point sizes (no blur).
- From your reports: '(Complete)' on finished objectives, the 'Quests: 9/40' line, and the alerts 'You need to be closer...', 'You don't have a pet!', 'Thank you for your report!'.
- Correct colours: plain words are no longer coloured as spells (e.g. 'cleansing' in Improved Mend Pet); professions, creature types and races get the term colour; ordinary words like 'increases' or 'chance' are plain text (942 fixes).
- Item names in objectives stay English until the full item bank arrives.
